_doc: Champion/challenger fleet registry, schema fleet-v2 (2026-06-25 grid rebuild). AN ACCOUNT IS NOT A STRATEGY. Every account is a (gate-strictness x contract-sizing) profile; EVERY validated strategy in automation/state/fleet/strategies.py runs on EVERY account via fleet_executor.plan_all. The account only decides how SELECTIVE the entry gate is (gate_override) and how BIG the position is (sizing = strike depth + qty + risk cap). NO direction locks, NO per-account strategy silos (the old PUT_ONLY / loose-aggressive-as-a-strategy framing was the bug J flagged). NEVER store secrets here -- key_ref points to the GITIGNORED secrets.json. Account#/equity broker-verified 2026-06-20.

probe_arm._doc: PROBE ARM (2026-07-10 ship, amended TWICE same-session). J directive 2026-07-10: '6 arms and nothing took a trade... why isn't 1 arm set to take riskier trades?' Diagnosis: every fleet arm's gate_override only ADDS selectivity on top of an already-passed=True shared-signal tick (fleet_executor._gate_check never rescues a passed=False tick) -- so the COHORT/TIER gates baked into build_shared_signal.py's passed-derivation apply UNIFORMLY to every arm regardless of how loose its OWN gate_override is. ONE designated arm trades ONE specific, gate-provenance-reviewed blocked cohort at the account's MINIMUM size plus a nearer strike, converting blocked signals into forward evidence instead of silence. AMENDMENT 1 (automation/state/participation-cascade.json evidence): min_entry_premium -- NOT the cohort gates -- is the real #1 blocker in practice (18 of 31 arm-events on 07-10 alone), because the fleet's own far-OTM/bold sizing tiers price their natural 0DTE contracts under the $0.30 floor. The floor is NEVER bypassed (its anti-spread-noise evidence is real and stays fully intact) -- fleet_executor.PROBE_STRIKE_TIERS gives the probe's OWN contracts a nearer (ATM-class, standalone table) strike than the arm's normal bold/OTM table, so they clear the SAME floor on their own merits. AMENDMENT 2 (markdown/audits/GATE-PROVENANCE-SWEEP-2026-07-10.md, commit 54d5840): a rigorous, pre-registered, hash-pinned, 19/19-test-covered per-gate audit NARROWED the bypass from a broad blocklist to an explicit allowlist, build_shared_signal.PROBE_ALLOWED_VERDICTS = {'SKIP_BULL_1100_1200'} exactly. block_elite_bull is EXPLICITLY NOT bypassed -- its SS-B revalidation (SAME session, frozen pre-registration, `analysis/recommendations/block-elite-bull-ssb-revalidation.json`) proved KEEP: n=28, OLD total -$560.00 -> SS-B total -$3,873.60, ~6.9x WORSE under the SAME structure-stop exit shape this probe arm's own ribbon_ride entries use -- probing it would spend real paper capital re-testing a question the codebase just answered with hash-pinned rigor. SKIP_BULL_1100_1200 IS bypassed -- REVALIDATE verdict: thin (IS n=11 WR=9.1%, OOS n=1), pre-dates SS-B, and 07-10 was the first genuinely-live block of a SUPER-tier (not just ELITE) signal since ratification -- exactly the shape of gate a min-size forward probe should test. block_bull_ribbon_flip independently reconfirmed (3rd audit) ABSENT/unarmed -- no bypass built for it. Mechanism: build_shared_signal.py's _probe_passed_blocks() (PROBE_COHORT_LIVE flag) emits signal['probe'] off the BOLD ledger: passed=True ONLY when action is in PROBE_ALLOWED_VERDICTS AND a real named ENTRY_TRIGGERS-member trigger fired. fleet_executor.py's _probe_plan() consumes it ONLY for this arm_id, ONLY when the arm's NORMAL plan_all pass produced no ENTER this tick (never double-fires alongside a normal entry), ONLY for ribbon_ride (vwap_continuation is a live REST detector, not core-gated -- no cohort block to bypass). qty is HARD-CLAMPED to params.min_contracts (ignores _qty_for's sizing tiers and _apply_recency_min_sizing -- already at floor). Every OTHER gate stays fully on: kill-switch, PDT, min_entry_premium floor (unweakened), per-trade risk cap, entry-time floor/ceiling, one-position -- all run downstream in fleet_executor.finalize()/risk_gate.check_order/fleet_live._place_live, untouched by this block. Reason tag 'PROBE_ARM cohort=<bypassed verdict, SKIP_ prefix stripped>' makes every fill attributable. Instant de-arm: set enabled=false here (byte-identical revert -- _is_probe_active short-circuits False, the arm falls back to its normal risky-x-loose gate_override path unchanged). Guards: automation/state/fleet/test_probe_arm.py (39/39).
